description: Build a native DAW PROJECT from stems: each stem on its own audio track from bar 1, optional MIDI tracks (the written parts) beside them, on your tempo (bpm or tempo_map) — Logic Pro (.logicx) or Ableton Live (.als), zipped. The deliverable after doseedo_render_score (pass from_job: its job_id and the stems, MIDI and tempo come from that job) or after any renders / separations you made (stems: [{name, audio_url}] — result links work as-is). Async: job_id → doseedo_wait_task (~30–90 s) → file (pre-signed zip, curl -o session.zip <url>, 24 h). Cancel: the plane has no stop for a running session build — it runs to completion (credits spent), the job ends as canceled and its output is discarded. Only a job still queued at the plane is refunded by the plane's own failure refund.

from_job.description: MCP: a doseedo_render_score job_id — its stems, parts' MIDI and tempo are used (no other input needed).

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Any unique string for THIS request (e.g. a UUID). Re-sending the same call with the same key after a timeout returns the same job instead of starting a second one.

midi_tracks.description: Optional MIDI tracks: [{name, notes:[{pitch, start_beats, duration_beats, velocity?}]}].

stems.description: [{name, audio_url | audio_key, gain_db?, position_beats?}] — the audio tracks, in order.

tempo_map.description: Tempo changes [{beat, bpm}] for the project.

name: doseedo_session_from_stems
title: Stems → a DAW session
